about: Modwerk source-only note-accumulator packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/note-accumulator.

mods.title: Per-step Note Accumulator
mods.summary: Each enabled audio step remembers its own pitch increment between visits. Positive values climb, negative values descend, and the pitch wraps to the original note at the chosen range.
mods.description: Each enabled audio step remembers its own pitch increment between visits. Positive values climb, negative values descend, and the pitch wraps to the original note at the chosen range.
mods.author: sumedho
mods.on_unit: The author reports this build fully tested and working with all six mods on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, for about one to two hours including project save/reload and a power cycle (2026-10-14).
